cyclic_aging.description: Marginal cost of discharging 1 kWh from different SOC segments, based on a power-law model (b=2) and a 100% DoD cycle life of 3840 cycles.

calendar_aging.description: Breakpoints for the piecewise-linear calendar aging cost function (SOS2), derived from Collath et al. (2023).

alpha_sweep.description: Alpha parameter sweep configuration for meta-optimization

optimization_notes.require_sequential_segment_activation: Enables strict sequential segment filling via power flow binaries (Eq. 609-610). Provides fastest solve times and prevents parallel segment charging.
optimization_notes.lifo_constraint: Perfect LIFO enforcement (no tolerance). Segment j can only have energy if segment j-1 is exactly full.
optimization_notes.performance: Empirical testing shows this configuration provides fastest solve times (14-15 sec for 24h horizon)
